title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
script:
Microsoft recorded ten billion dollars in revenue from OpenAI.
This money flowed in from commercial arrangements during the quarter ending September 30.
The massive sum includes direct revenue-sharing payments tied to their ongoing partnership.
The financial milestone highlights just how deeply dependent both technology giants remain on each other.
Cloud infrastructure costs and massive computing power continue driving these high-stakes financial transactions.
Can Microsoft sustain this enormous quarterly intake as AI operational expenses climb?
